max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed to the OVN Northbound database.

max_log_entries.description: Maximum number of in-memory log entries retained per client connection for debugging and monitoring.

connection_timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Connections not receiving activity for this duration will be closed.

ssl_enable.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for remote connections. Must be true to use SSL certificates.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file used to identify the OVN Northbound database server.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file corresponding to the server certificate.

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify client certificates when mutual TLS is required.

ssl_ciphers.description: Colon-separated list of allowed SSL cipher suites (e.g., 'ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256'). Leave empty to use OpenSSL defaults.

local.description: Local IP address the OVN Northbound database server binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, or a specific interface IP).

peers.description: List of other OVN Northbound database servers for clustering (HA mode). Each entry defines a peer node.

name.description: Unique name for the peer node (e.g., 'ovnnb0', 'ovnnb1').

address.description: IP address or hostname of the peer OVN Northbound database server.

port.description: TCP port on which the peer node listens (typically 6641 for OVN Northbound DB).

remote_address.description: Address of the OVN Southbound database server for cross-database lookups (e.g., to resolve chassis information).

remote_port.description: Port of the OVN Southbound database server (default 6642).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting. Should be disabled in production for performance.
